data.narrative:
LabGenius is a seed-stage biotech and health company founded by James Field that has raised $73M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 3 public peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private companies in the Biotech & Health sector, including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Only one valuation method proved applicable given data constraints. Stage-Progression analysis uses $27M as a proxy base value derived from total capital raised, then applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement in venture markets. This yields an implied valuation of $68M. A peer-median approach was not viable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables with aligned valuation tiers within the biotech cohort. Public-comp anchoring using the sector P/S median of 8.1x could not be applied because LabGenius does not publicly disclose revenue.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $57M to $78M, centered on a median of $68M. This range reflects ±15% variance around the stage-progression point estimate. Key uncertainties include the limited methodology count (one method only), the absence of revenue data to enable multiples-based valuation, and sparse comparable granularity at the seed stage within biotech. Any refinement would require either disclosed financial metrics or identification of additional precisely-staged peer transactions.
